items.source: ApiVersionDeprecationHandler based on RFC 9745 and RFC 8594 that provides the option to set the "Deprecation" and "Sunset" response headers, as well as to add "Link" headers with further details about both.
items.translation: ApiVersionDeprecationHandler 基于RFC 9745和RFC 8594，提供设置“Deprecation”和“Sunset”响应头选项的功能，并可添加包含两者进一步详情的“Link”头。
